review_basis: Targeted source review, package checks and documented hardware limitations; not a full OS audit

requirements.evidence: Software-only regression reproduced invalid UEFI descriptor consumption. pi5_probe_support.c now uses the existing production validator before any summary read/arithmetic; invalid layouts return no summary. Strict C17 and ASan/UBSan regressions cover stride, alignment, truncation, version and overflow. Actual firmware pointer validity remains hardware-dependent. See SAFETY_REVIEW.md.

Software-only regression reproduced the empty UART string after ConOut. A separate console cursor preserves the complete original UART text. Multi-chunk, missing-sink and failing-console tests pass. No physical UART delivery or MMIO correctness is asserted.

Host regression reproduced overlapping live allocations. One nonblocking per-pool atomic lock serializes all allocation/free transactions and zeroing; atomic ownership reads cover DMA/cache observers. 24000 mixed concurrent requests per run, busy-release retention, bounds, owner and double-free tests pass under plain, ASan/UBSan and TSan. Initialization must precede publication; owners must quiesce CPU/device use before release. This is allocator software evidence, not physical DMA/IRQ approval.

The ordinary AArch64 efi_main remains a generic QEMU-specific development entry, not a Pi boot image. The separate diagnostic probe's recorded map/UART defects are corrected and it compiles, but physical entry, firmware handoff and electrical approval remain unverified. No new board startup or MMIO configuration is introduced.
Register widths, volatile semantics, actual mappings and barriers on BCM2712/RP1 have not been independently established on physical equipment. Probe GIC/PCIe metadata paths declare mmio_access=none.
Physical interrupt delivery, concurrency, DMA ownership/alignment and cache coherency are not established by host fixtures or QEMU.

ELECTRICAL_PRE_POWER.md supplies E01-E10 evidence/acceptance requirements for supply, voltages, pinout, polarity, wiring, current, backfeeding and shorts. No physical review or measurement has been performed; every electrical result remains NOT_VERIFIED. Vendor references are not electrical verification.
Exact firmware/board compatibility and DTB/non-OSI redistribution rights unresolved. No formatting, flashing or EEPROM procedure is approved.
Community entry point refuses live serial access and only imports logs or generates labeled synthetic data; focused regression tests exercise this boundary.

Strict C17 warnings-as-errors, focused ASan/UBSan/TSan tests, affected memory/DMA/MMU host fixtures and probe cross-compilation pass. Static analysis scope and an unrelated whole-driver analyzer finding are recorded separately in SAFETY_REVIEW.md; this is not exhaustive pointer/lifetime/overflow verification.
